patterns: APPSC asks one-line identifications with an AP tilt: Lepakshi = Vijayanagara paintings / stone bull / hanging pillar; Tadipatri = gopurams surpassing Hampi Vittala.
Hampi location facts recur nationally: Virupaksha and Vittala (56 musical pillars) at Hampi, capital on the Tungabhadra, Hampi ruins.
APPSC keys credit Hazara Rama (Ramachandra) temple to Krishnadevaraya; mark that unless Devaraya I is offered.
Typical traps mix temples of other dynasties (Brihadeswara, Dilwara, Khajuraho) into 'not correctly matched' items.
App MCQs add many patron/renovation details and multi-statement items deeper than PYQs, plus debate-style items APPSC never asks.
